# fluss-go v0.1.0-beta.11

This maintenance prerelease refreshes the supported Go patch levels and the
reviewed dependency pins used by the root module and optional adapters. It does
not change the exported fluss-go API, Fluss wire protocol, or client operation
semantics.

## Highlights

- Raises the recommended toolchain to Go 1.26.6 and the supported patched
  minimums to Go 1.25.13 and Go 1.26.6.
- Includes the standard-library fixes for `GO-2026-5972` and `GO-2026-6090`.
- Updates the root protobuf runtime to 1.36.12.
- Updates optional adapters to OpenTelemetry Go 1.46.0, Alibaba Cloud OSS SDK
  1.6.0, and AWS SDK core 1.45.1 with S3 1.110.0.
- Updates the GitHub Actions Task installer to 2.2.0.

## Upgrade notes

- No exported API, Fluss wire behavior, configuration contract, or operation
  semantics change from beta.10.
- Use Go 1.25.13 or newer in the 1.25 series, or Go 1.26.6 or newer in the 1.26
  series. Older patch releases do not contain all required standard-library
  security fixes.
- All four optional adapter modules are published at beta.11 and require the
  beta.11 root module.
- The OpenTelemetry adapter still imports only the stable metrics API. SDK,
  reader, exporter, flush, and shutdown ownership remain with the application.
- The compatibility target remains Apache Fluss `0.9.1-incubating` at commit
  `6bf969f71af8d6f9cc37383ab89ae46a58b0e227`.

## Upgrade documentation

- Review the [complete changelog][changelog], [installation guidance][readme],
  and [supported-version policy][security].
- Optional module manuals: [HDFS][hdfs-adapter],
  [Alibaba Cloud OSS][oss-adapter], [OpenTelemetry][otel-adapter], and
  [AWS SDK v2 S3][s3-adapter].
- Dependency ownership and reviewed pins are recorded in the
  [build-versus-buy register][build-vs-buy].
- Maintainers should use the [single-PR release process][releasing], with the
  matching [coding rules][coding-guidelines] and
  [contributor guidance][contributing]. The pull-request template change and
  the corrected historical beta.10 links have no client upgrade impact.

This is a pre-v1 release. Pin the root and adapter module versions and review
the changelog before upgrading.
